label: USA (Sibly)
source: Ebenezer Sibly (1787); the most used US chart, but the signing time is not documented.
notes: Competing times range from about 02:13 to 17:10 LMT; the date is secure.

label: United Kingdom
source: Union with Ireland Act 1800, effective from the first moment of 1 January 1801.

label: Ukraine
source: Verkhovna Rada vote on 24 Aug 1991; ~18:00 is the commonly used time (Campion).
notes: The vote time is reported variously between late afternoon and 18:00; treat angles as unreliable.

label: Russia (1990)
source: Date of the sovereignty declaration, now Russia Day.
notes: An alternative chart is 25 Dec 1991, when the RSFSR became the Russian Federation.

label: Russia (1991)
source: Date of the renaming, coinciding with the end of the USSR.

label: People's Republic of China
source: The founding ceremony in Tiananmen Square began at 15:00 local time.

label: India
source: Independence took effect at midnight, 14–15 August 1947.

label: Israel
event: Declaration of the Establishment of the State
source: Ben-Gurion began reading the declaration at 16:00 local time.
notes: Some charts assume summer time (UTC+3), which moves the angles by about 15°.

label: Germany (reunified)
source: Unification Treaty took effect at midnight; German summer time had ended on 30 Sep 1990.

label: France (Fifth Republic)
source: Constitution promulgated 4 Oct and in force on publication, 5 Oct 1958.

label: Japan (sovereignty restored)
event: Treaty of San Francisco in force
source: The peace treaty entered into force at 22:30 Tokyo time, ending the occupation.
